groups.title_ar: روابط مؤقتة موقعة للوسائط الخاصة مع تحقق الوصول الحالي
groups.baseline_gap: No per-object temporary private URL implementation was found in the recovered source; session-only private readers were preserved behind the default-off migration switch.

recovery.notes: No new tables or saved tickets/grants; source originals are included in the existing library inventory. Fresh current sessions and explicit test trust must be supplied after restore.

points.original_text: الملفات الخاصة تقدم بروابط مؤقتة موقعة.
points.required_behavior_and_evidence: Issue short-lived per-object byte URLs bound to the current browser/session, exact source version/content, purpose and key generation. Every GET/HEAD/Range rechecks the real domain reader, current rights, source bytes and final session/source/expiry pins. Native staff, requester portal, library, recording and citation entry points use signed URLs; a ticket never grants independent access, and all unsigned private byte readers deny when enabled.

recovery.notes: Reuses immutable transcript/action journals already counted; fixture includes two editorial versions, review, actual Mufti meaning approval and withdrawal. Thirteen independent current-access denials follow restore.

points.required_behavior_and_evidence: Actual ORGANIZER identities create recording transcript derivative versions, independently review and withdraw them through native CSRF forms, exact source-version CAS and separate current per-resource operational/media grants. Only an actual MUFTI can approve meaning; canonical approved answers, original audio and precise/timed source permissions are preserved and rechecked after the final callbacks. Restored editorial history cannot supply present authorization.
